title: Portfolio project Markdown frontmatter
description: The frontmatter structure for PORTFOLIO_HOME/projects/<project_id>/README.md and supporting Markdown documents.

title.description: Display title. README.md uses this as the project name.

project_name.description: Backward-compatible project name alias for title.

brief.description: Short description shown on the projects list.

start_date.description: Project start date or human-readable start label.

end_date.description: Project end date or present label.

status.description: Project status, such as active, archived, or experimental.

featured.description: Whether to highlight the project in a featured list.
